# EcomSEO

> Profit-focused ecommerce SEO agency. We help ecommerce brands scale organic revenue with data-driven SEO strategies.

## About

EcomSEO is an ecommerce SEO agency founded in 2023 by Fabian van Til. We work with direct-to-consumer ecommerce brands across 8 European markets, in the 6 to 9 figure revenue range. Full-service: technical SEO, content, link building, digital PR, and AI infrastructure.

## Founder

Fabian van Til is a Dutch entrepreneur based in the Netherlands. He is the founder of EcomSEO, an ecommerce SEO agency, and Akravo, an omnichannel organic growth agency.

- Job title: Entrepreneur and organic growth strategist
- Personal site and canonical profile: https://fabianvantil.com
- X/Twitter: https://x.com/til_fabian
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/fabian-van-til
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@fabian-ecomseo
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fabianvantil

## Services

- Ecommerce SEO: technical SEO, on-page, category and product page optimisation
- Platform SEO: Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Adobe Commerce, Amazon
- Content: keyword research, content writing, topical authority
- Off-page: link building, digital PR, outreach
- International SEO across the UK, Germany, Austria, France, Belgium, Spain, Italy and the Netherlands

## Languages

The site is published in English, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Dutch.
